quarterly_data.quarter: Micron press release: Micron Invests in New York Critical Minerals Processing (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Micron will provide strategic funding that enables Indium Corporation to expand its refining and manufacturing operations in Rome, New York, restarting domestic processing of critical minerals used in advanced semiconductor manufacturing; the companies will enter into a long-term supply agreement giving Micron access to these high-purity minerals. It is the latest investment under the plan Micron announced in July to invest up to $3 billion in the U.S. semiconductor supply-chain ecosystem (no amount stated for this investment). Chief procurement officer Ben Tessone: securing these inputs is essential to Micron's long-term growth and technology roadmap.
quarterly_data.figure: part of the up to $3 billion U.S. supply-chain plan
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: supplier (critical minerals; planned long-term supply agreement)
